rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: High-performance MCP server implementation in Rust providing 18 built-in tools for file operations, HTTP requests, calculations, and system information. Features a modern WebUI control panel with real-time SSE updates, multi-transport support (HTTP and SSE), concurrency control, working directory restrictions, dangerous command blacklisting, and command injection detection with two-step confirmation.
